author: Zach Townes
description: Campaign manager for D&D and TTRPG gamemasters with a hosted MCP server. Your AI reads and edits a typed campaign database live: 14 entity schemas, knowledge graphs, open threads, and a collaborative wiki, with GM secrets enforced server side. One OAuth click connects Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor; the free tier includes full MCP access.
name: Grimoire
